findings.summary: Exact deterministic authorization-ref and identity enforcement is repaired; adversarial wrong-ref and wrong-identity cases fail.

STILL OPEN: immutable Gate Records require reciprocal supersedes/superseded_by links, but an already-published immutable predecessor with superseded_by null cannot be corrected; the validator also accepts the same agent identity as the alleged independent rechecker. Repair by using forward-only immutable successor links with independently verified distinct rechecker identity, or another append-only linkage model, and add regression tests using an already-published predecessor.
Critical canonical policy structures now fail closed under the required evidence, role, exception, release identity, staging, owner-protection, and finding-policy mutations.

scripts/verify_integration.py and scripts/validate_gate_records.py do not retrieve the PR-visible Gate Record representation. discover_record_objects loads stored JSON from refs, then validate_record_object compares that same stored JSON to itself. A valid-looking or mutated PR comment can therefore disagree with the authoritative commit without release validation detecting it. Fetch and parse the exact PR comment/export ledger, bind each comment to its declared Gate-Record-Commit, require one-to-one equality with every authoritative ref/object, and test the full release path rather than only the helper function.

Complete-ledger validation trusts whichever custom refs happen to exist locally and has no independently enumerated expected PR-visible evidence set. Omitting an historical Gate Record ref removes it from discovery, allowing unresolved serious history to disappear. Fetch/enumerate the complete canonical PR ref namespace and reconcile it bidirectionally against all PR-visible Gate Record declarations before authorization; add selective-omission tests.
